snippet.title: Chantey - Trailer
snippet.description:
Chantey is a top-down adventure and rhythm game where you play as a stowaway on a Spanish merchant vessel seeking adventure, riches, and fame. In an alternate history where Golden Age pirate mythology meets heavy metal, collect mystical sea chanteys, navigate treacherous waters, and survive oceanic horrors. Exclusively on Chromatic, preorder today: https://modretro.com/products/chantey
